description: This file defines the RetryableMalformedResponseParser class in the Aws\S3 namespace, which converts malformed responses into retryable error types when interacting with AWS S3. It extends AbstractParser and implements methods to invoke parsing and handle exceptions related to parsing errors.

classes.name: RetryableMalformedResponseParser
classes.description: A parser class that handles malformed responses from AWS S3 and converts them into retryable error responses, facilitating error handling and retry logic within the SDK.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser callback and optional exception class used for retryable error handling.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the parser on a given command and response, catching parsing exceptions and converting them into retryable AWS exceptions.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Delegates parsing of a specific response member from a stream to the underlying parser.
